text: Gas smell near the boiler since this morning. My dad is 81 and lives with me.
Sparks came from the socket when I plugged in the heater, and now the wall feels hot.
The mould in my son's bedroom is back and he's coughing all night. I've reported this twice.
No heating for over a week. We've been using a small plug-in heater. My mum is elderly and feels the cold.
The stair handrail came away from the wall last month and it's still not fixed.
Big crack across the bedroom ceiling, and plaster is starting to drop.
Mice in the kitchen and droppings near the food cupboards. I have a toddler.
Flat is freezing even with the radiators on. I'm pregnant and worried.
Bath won't drain and the water smells bad.
Back step has broken and I use a walking frame.
Black mould behind the wardrobe, and the walls feel wet.
The bedroom gets dangerously hot and the windows won't open.
Light switch buzzes and the lights flicker when it's turned on.
Damp patch keeps growing on the living room wall.
The kitchen tap has been dripping for a few days.
Something's wrong with the loft hatch and I'm worried about it.
